title: Completed arbitrary free module is flat Mittag-Leffler
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, and assume $R$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. For any set $A$, put $F=\bigoplus_{a\in A}R$, the $R$-module of finitely supported families $(r_a)_{a\in A}$ with componentwise operations. For $n\ge1$, let $I^nF$ be the submodule generated by $rx$ with $r\in I^n$ and $x\in F$. Put $\widehat F=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}F/I^nF$, the module of families of residue classes compatible under the quotient maps, with componentwise operations. Then $\widehat F$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and is a Mittag-Leffler $R$-module [def-trf-mittag-leffler-module].

proof.text: Let $F=\bigoplus_{a\in A}R$ and let $\iota:\widehat F\to R^A$ be the canonical coordinate map. By [lem-trf-completed-free-into-product-universally-injective], for every $R$-module $Q$ the map $Q\otimes_R\iota$ is injective. Let $C=\operatorname{coker}(\iota)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact], tensor products preserve the surjection to the cokernel, so tensoring $0\to\widehat F\xrightarrow{\iota}R^A\to C\to0$ with any $Q$ is exact; hence this is a universally exact short exact sequence.

source.place: Tag 05DJ proof, first sentence and the universally exact sequence induced by Tag 05BC

proof.text: The product module $R^A$ is flat by [lem-trf-product-noetherian-flat-mittag-leffler]. Applying [lem-trf-universally-exact-flat-submodule] to the universally exact sequence from Step 1 gives that $\widehat F$ is flat over $R$.

source.place: Tag 05DJ proof, middle sentences: Tag 058P applied to the universally exact completion-to-product sequence

proof.text: The product module $R^A$ is Mittag-Leffler by [lem-trf-product-noetherian-flat-mittag-leffler]. Applying [lem-trf-pure-submodule-mittag-leffler] to the same universally exact sequence gives that its submodule $\widehat F$ is Mittag-Leffler. Thus $\widehat F$ is both flat and Mittag-Leffler, as required.
